technique_name: Compose a 100-word reflection of the best qualities of a teacher.
description: The best qualities of a teacher are often those that are intangible and difficult to quantify, such as patience and a passion for teaching. The best teachers lead by example, demonstrating a genuine commitment to the growth and development of the students in their care. Great teachers are always encouraging and supportive, creating a safe and welcoming learning environment.
